description: This PHP class is a Data Access Object (DAO) for managing EmailConfiguration entities within the OrangeHRM system. It provides methods to retrieve and save email configuration data from/to the database.

classes.name: EmailConfigurationDao
classes.description: A DAO class for performing database operations related to email configuration in the system.

methods.name: getEmailConfiguration
methods.description: Retrieves the email configuration entity from the database, returning null if none exists.

methods.name: saveEmailConfiguration
methods.description: Persists the provided EmailConfiguration entity into the database and returns it.
